text:
Ashley: thanks everyone for joining today. quick follow-up thread for the townhall Q&A — 3 asks i want clarified: dedicated GA date, private/on-prem prereqs, and hosted->dedicated migration steps. starting this thread to collect owners and links.

Mike: +1 — dedicated GA date is urgent for sales decks. i heard 'early may' during the talk, can we lock a commit date?

Rajesh: for clarity — internal GA target is May 12, public GA week of May 20 pending final perf validations. will confirm by EOD Tuesday.

Sophia: can you confirm SLA tiers and whether dedicated includes encryption-at-rest by default? need this for compliance questions.

Rajesh: SLA tiers: standard (99.9% reserved) and enterprise (99.95% + extended support add-on). encryption at rest: yes — dedicated uses customer KMS by default if provided; otherwise platform-managed keys. doc: https://redwood.ai/infra/dedicated-ga (internal).

Mike: perfect — can we get that on the public roadmap page and notify AMs? sales needs a clean blurb.

Kate: private/on-prem follow-up — what's the minimal infra footprint? GPUs, control plane HA, network egress rules?

Rajesh: minimal on-prem: 4x A10G-equivalent for small clusters + a control-plane VM (2CPU/8GB) for the private control plane. HA recommendations are in the checklist. networking: need outbound to our control plane endpoints or a bundled air-gapped package. i'll share the checklist.

ops-bot: New doc created: /docs/internal/private-deploy-checklist — https://redwood.ai/internal/private-checklist :memo:

Sophia: migration question — hosted->dedicated: do we just swap API keys or is there a blue/green flow? any expected downtime?

Ashley: migration flow is blue-green capable. minimal downtime if caches warmed. short steps: 1) reserve capacity 2) deploy model to dedicated 3) run smoke/perf tests 4) switch route. owners: @Rajesh to own docs, @Kate to own migration template (repo + PR), @Mike to notify sales/AMs. pls ack owners.

Mike: :thumbsup: ack — i’ll coordinate comms with AMs and finalize the sales blurb by 2025-04-25.

Kate: ack — i’ll create a migration-template repo and open PR by EOD Thu. ETA for template: 2025-05-01.

Rajesh: ack — i’ll update the GA docs and checklist by 2025-04-28. quick sample CLI to reserve capacity (will add to docs):

```
redwoodctl reserve --pool dedicated-small --gpus a10g:4 --commit 3mo --name team-x
```

Ashley: Sophia — do you need an eval harness for perf curves + token-level cost estimates?

Sophia: yes please. need sample prompts, token counts, and a harness to run p95/p99 latency. also want a cost per-token table for the sample workload.

Rajesh: will include the perf harness link in the docs: https://redwood.ai/internal/evals/harness

Ashley: action summary: Rajesh — docs + checklist by 2025-04-28; Kate — migration template by 2025-05-01; Mike — sales notification by 2025-04-25. i’ll follow up in #eng-platform with links and a calendar sync. anything else?

Mike: please add a short note about automatic fallbacks (model variant fallback & region fallback) — sales often asks about graceful degradation.

Rajesh: good call, i'll add the fallback policy section to the GA doc.

Sophia: thanks all, this helps a lot. :rocket:
